recent_posts.title: Issue #325 - UI, Worflows, Patterns and more
recent_posts.summary: Weekly curated digest for Unity game developers covering UI techniques, workflow scaling, and visual effects. Highlights include rendering custom meshes in Unity UI, a liquid bottle shader effect tutorial, Disco Elysium-style 2.5D graphics with Camera Projection Mapping, and scaling Unity workflows for medium-to-large projects using Assembly Definitions and Git best practices. Also covers bringing Unity games to Steam Deck, ragdoll creation, scene transitions without singletons, Unity 6.4 new features, and the Observer pattern vs alternatives in C#. Includes a curated list of open-source Unity tools spanning terrain erosion, UI management, dialogue frameworks, and AI automation skills for Unity.
